playlist_title: CNS4 - Two-dimensional neuron models and phase plane analysis
description:
This playlist focuses on explaining the dynamics of single neurons in two dimensions. Phase plane analysis shows how threshold phenomenar arise and why there are differences between type 1 and type 2 neuron models. Concrete examples of neuron models are the FitzHugh-Nagumo model and the Morris-Lecar model, but even the four-dimensional Hodgkin-Huxley model is systematically reduced to two dimensions. Interestingly, a further reduction to one dimension is possible and yields the nonlinear integrate-and-fire model.

CNS stands for Computational NeuroScience.
